summary: This configuration defines how receipt numbers are generated for fee collections and refunds, including options for prefixes, suffixes, and class-wise numbering. It allows for customization of receipt sequences.
steps: Select all classes or specific classes for separate counters.
Define a prefix (e.g., 'TAS-') for the receipt number.
Define a suffix (e.g., '-25-26' for the academic session) for the receipt number.
For refund receipts, configure a separate prefix (e.g., 'R-').
business_rules: Receipt numbers can be configured with prefixes and suffixes.
Counters can be separated based on class for unique numbering sequences.
In 90-95% of cases, direct numbers (without prefix/suffix) are used.
Refund receipts have their own numbering setup, distinct from regular fee receipts.
The system automatically increments the receipt counter for both fee and refund receipts.
important_notes: Prefixes and suffixes help identify the type or session of the receipt.
Class-wise separation allows for unique numbering sequences per class, useful for different school sections.
The system automatically updates the counter, ensuring unique receipt numbers.
questions: How do I configure automatic receipt numbering in the ERP system?
